title: Split-Zero arithmetic cohomology: SGA comparison, constituent curvature and Laplacian control
scope: The 765-page Split-Zero paper retains the original theta-function source, zero multiplicities, full source mass, the coordinate S=k/2+iu and the least-norm quotient metric. Through R57 it adds the explicit Hochschild comparison kernel, constituent curvature and Laplacian control to the endpoint, period and determinant calculations. A uniform arithmetic upper estimate is not established; no RH conclusion is claimed.
